response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_duration) AS avg_of_avg_duration, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratio FROM (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_duration) AS avg_duration, AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 GROUP BY rating) subquery;

assumptions.assumption: "For each `rating`" refers to each rating present in the filtered dataset (films with replacement_cost > 20.99), not necessarily all five MPAA ratings. If a rating has no films meeting the filter, it is excluded from the final average.
